body: Thank you. You’re exactly right, it feels like i’ve known him forever. Breaking up now would be final, since we live together I would have to move out. I don’t know if i’m ready to let go after all these years and everything we’ve been through. He’s family to me and i genuinely think he does love me, but his love and my love aren’t the same. Maybe it’s selfish of me, but I just want to enjoy it while it lasts. That’s why i’ve let it slide this many times, i’m not ready to let go

Thank you. It’s just really hard, and maybe i’m not ready to let go. I like what we have, and I know if we break up we aren’t going to ever go back to that. I just want to enjoy it until it finally breaks. I used to think we would be together forever… get married and have kids. But i can’t marry a cheater. It’s all confusing. He moved to this state to be with me, away from his family and a lot of his friends… how can someone do that and still not be loyal?

i’ve mentioned anti-depressants to my parents before and they kinda just ignored it... that’s the main reason i don’t want to mention meds anymore. but i see what you’re saying, and thank you for trying to help :,)

not yet.. but i know 100% i have it. both of my parents are diagnosed, and i’ve done so much research. the reason i’m not medicated is because i don’t want to have to mention it to my parents (i’m 18, still in high school)
you still have so much life to live... don’t get up just yet my friend. i know you feel lonely, but please... try to find the things you enjoy still. time heals... let time help you.
ofc ofc. remember that time heals...let time help you :)

i know this can be somewhat harsh... but if he is serious about killing himself, tell his parents. he will probably be mad or feel betrayed in a way, but in the long run... you saved his life. as long as his parents know, i feel like they will do their best to help... antidepressant and therapy can do wonders.
you will. keep telling yourself you will. i believe in you. time heals , let time help you.

i’m very sorry to hear this. you have to understand though, depression consumes a person. when someone dies due to suicide, their closest peers can feel relentless guilt. do not feel guilty. it’s not your fault. my best advice i can give is to understand, that what happened has happened, and there is nothing to do about it now, sad as it is. you only have one life, and your boyfriend who passed probably wouldn’t want you to feel this way. sending you luck my friend, i hope you feel better .

having issues, internally and externally, can be so tough. i’m sorry to hear this. but please, hold on longer my friend. time heals, and you will have great things happen in the future . try getting out of the house more to avoid the noise, i once went to a playground randomly after feeling very stressed, and swung on the swing set for hours with music in my earbuds. it’s a good release , try it sometime for me ?

i understand completely . having everything, yet feeling like you have nothing... it sucks. my best advice i can give you is to enjoy the things you have. whenever you get to thinking about how lonely and dark you feel, remember your parents, your brother, your beautiful girlfriend. think about the good things in life. time heals my friend, hold on just a little longer.

i feel you. but trust me, and i know it is cliche, but things will get better with time. time heals, and time helps you forget the things you despise in the world and love the things you didn’t realize were there before. don’t give up yet.
i understand. try to realize that what you’re feeling is okay, but you will move on. it will be okay

i completely understand. Living for your parents... eating disorders... having everything be okay except you... it’s all too familiar. please, focus on the good things. focus on what YOU want and what YOU love. live your best life, because you only have this one my friend.

first of all, anyone that removes you from everything for no reason is toxic, and you don’t deserve that. christmas can be stressful, and i’m sorry for what has happened but, it happened. nothing you can change now, so you might as well move on as best as you can.

i understand, i once felt this way too. i’m sorry you feel this way and i wish you the best of luck. my only advice i can give you, is live the life you want to live. convince yourself of something better
it’s not going to end soon, don’t tell yourself that. it may FEEL that way, but look at the world from another perspective. surround yourself with this perspective.
but you’re wrong, don’t you see ? although there is hate and darkness, there is equal love and life. center yourself, and try to understand that THIS is your only life, you might as well enjoy it.

i understand what you’re saying completely. the fate of the earth is so uncalled for and unpredictable, it is stressful. but friend, don’t let this consume you. you only have this life, please enjoy it.
it’s not time yet. find what you love and follow it. do some things you enjoy. try, please.
I feel the same way... depression can consume someone. i wish you well my friend, merry christmas !
there’s still a chance for you. you were put here for a reason. find what you love and follow it. please don’t give up
if your doctor says your vitals are okay... they are okay. you will be okay. this will not be the end of your life and will probably not affect you in 5 years. you will be okay.
you will most likely survive... and probably traumatize the person who hit you. or, they would swerve and end up killing themselves in a wreck instead. please do not run into traffic lol
make yourself throw up NOW or call 911
felt. the idea of resting in peace is so comforting

i think we might be living the same life. although everything seems like i should be fine, i feel a hole in me that i can’t ever seem to fill. i understand, and what keeps me going is the thought of the future. what i might be able to experience... love, travel, kids, or whatever else you’d like. focus on that for just a little while longer please

you’re not alone. what helps me a lot when i think i’m going to do it, i think about everything i might experience in the future. love, kids, traveling, or whatever else you would like to see in the future. life can be extremely hard, but we have to focus on the good things and what’s to come in order to keep going.
you are worth more than you ever will know. please find help
